package domain

import (
	"testing"
	"time"
)

func TestNormalizePracticeLearningActionReserveRequiresVersionedTargetsAndExactInstanceKey(t *testing.T) {
	base := PracticeLearningActionReserve{
		Schema:    StudentPracticeLearningActionReserveSchema,
		StudentID: "11111111-1111-4111-8111-111111111111", TaskInstanceID: "22222222-2222-4222-8222-222222222222",
		TaskRevisionID: "33333333-3333-4333-8333-333333333333", LearningActionID: "44444444-4444-4444-8444-444444444444",
		IdempotencyKey: "22222222-2222-4222-8222-222222222222", TaskRevisionDigest: "sha256:aaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaa",
		SurfaceClassification: "practice", LearningTargets: []LearningTargetRef{{Type: LearningTargetConcept, Key: "go.interfaces", Version: "v1"}}, OccurredAt: time.Now(),
	}
	normalized, err := NormalizePracticeLearningActionReserve(base)
	if err != nil || len(normalized.EnsureRequestHash) != 64 {
		t.Fatalf("reserve=%+v err=%v", normalized, err)
	}
	base.IdempotencyKey = "55555555-5555-4555-8555-555555555555"
	if _, err := NormalizePracticeLearningActionReserve(base); err == nil {
		t.Fatal("expected instance-key mismatch to fail")
	}
	base.IdempotencyKey = base.TaskInstanceID
	base.LearningTargets[0].Version = ""
	if _, err := NormalizePracticeLearningActionReserve(base); err == nil {
		t.Fatal("expected unversioned target to fail")
	}
}

func TestNormalizePracticeLearningActionBindingKeepsReservedTimestampFree(t *testing.T) {
	binding := PracticeLearningActionBinding{
		Schema: StudentPracticeLearningActionBindingSchema, LearningActionID: "11111111-1111-4111-8111-111111111111",
		StudentID: "22222222-2222-4222-8222-222222222222", TaskInstanceID: "33333333-3333-4333-8333-333333333333",
		TaskRevisionID: "44444444-4444-4444-8444-444444444444", TaskRevisionDigest: "sha256:aaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaa",
		SurfaceClassification: "project", LifecycleStatus: PracticeLearningActionReserved,
		LearningTargets: []LearningTargetRef{{Type: LearningTargetCapability, Key: "go.http", Version: "v1"}},
	}
	if _, err := NormalizePracticeLearningActionBinding(binding); err != nil {
		t.Fatal(err)
	}
	now := time.Now()
	binding.OpenedAt = &now
	if _, err := NormalizePracticeLearningActionBinding(binding); err == nil {
		t.Fatal("reserved binding must have no timestamps")
	}
}

func TestNormalizePracticeLearningActionBindingAcceptsStudentCancellationForReservedAndOpen(t *testing.T) {
	base := PracticeLearningActionBinding{
		Schema: StudentPracticeLearningActionBindingSchema, LearningActionID: "11111111-1111-4111-8111-111111111111",
		StudentID: "22222222-2222-4222-8222-222222222222", TaskInstanceID: "33333333-3333-4333-8333-333333333333",
		TaskRevisionID: "44444444-4444-4444-8444-444444444444", TaskRevisionDigest: "sha256:aaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaa",
		SurfaceClassification: "project", LifecycleStatus: PracticeLearningActionCancelled,
		LearningTargets: []LearningTargetRef{{Type: LearningTargetCapability, Key: "go.http", Version: "v1"}},
	}
	closedAt := time.Date(2026, 10, 2, 10, 0, 0, 0, time.UTC)

	reservedCancel := base
	reservedCancel.ClosedAt = &closedAt
	reservedCancel.CancelReason = "student_cancelled"
	if _, err := NormalizePracticeLearningActionBinding(reservedCancel); err != nil {
		t.Fatalf("student cancellation of RESERVED binding should normalize: %v", err)
	}

	openedAt := closedAt.Add(-time.Minute)
	openCancel := base
	openCancel.OpenedAt, openCancel.ClosedAt = &openedAt, &closedAt
	openCancel.CancelReason = "student_cancelled"
	if _, err := NormalizePracticeLearningActionBinding(openCancel); err != nil {
		t.Fatalf("student cancellation of OPEN binding should normalize: %v", err)
	}
}

func TestPracticeLearningActionCancelReasonsAreBoundToSourceLifecycle(t *testing.T) {
	cases := []struct {
		status PracticeLearningActionLifecycleStatus
		reason string
		allow  bool
	}{
		{PracticeLearningActionReserved, PracticeLearningActionCancelReason, true},
		{PracticeLearningActionOpen, PracticeLearningActionCancelReason, false},
		{PracticeLearningActionReserved, "student_cancelled", true},
		{PracticeLearningActionOpen, "student_cancelled", true},
		{PracticeLearningActionOpen, "unknown", false},
	}
	for _, testCase := range cases {
		if got := CanCancelPracticeLearningAction(testCase.status, testCase.reason); got != testCase.allow {
			t.Errorf("CanCancelPracticeLearningAction(%q, %q)=%v want %v", testCase.status, testCase.reason, got, testCase.allow)
		}
	}
}

func TestNormalizePracticeLearningActionBindingAcceptsLegacyProvisioningCancellation(t *testing.T) {
	base := PracticeLearningActionBinding{
		Schema: StudentPracticeLearningActionBindingSchema, LearningActionID: "11111111-1111-4111-8111-111111111111",
		StudentID: "22222222-2222-4222-8222-222222222222", TaskInstanceID: "33333333-3333-4333-8333-333333333333",
		TaskRevisionID: "44444444-4444-4444-8444-444444444444", TaskRevisionDigest: "sha256:aaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaa",
		SurfaceClassification: "project", LifecycleStatus: PracticeLearningActionCancelled,
		LearningTargets: []LearningTargetRef{{Type: LearningTargetCapability, Key: "go.http", Version: "v1"}},
		CancelReason:    PracticeLearningActionCancelReason,
	}
	closedAt := time.Date(2026, 10, 2, 10, 0, 0, 0, time.UTC)
	base.ClosedAt = &closedAt
	if _, err := NormalizePracticeLearningActionBinding(base); err != nil {
		t.Fatalf("provisioning failure cancellation of RESERVED binding should normalize: %v", err)
	}
	openedAt := closedAt.Add(-time.Minute)
	base.OpenedAt = &openedAt
	if _, err := NormalizePracticeLearningActionBinding(base); err != nil {
		t.Fatalf("historical OPEN provisioning-failure binding should remain readable: %v", err)
	}
}

func TestNormalizePracticeLearningActionReserveRejectsNonCanonicalWireIdentity(t *testing.T) {
	input := PracticeLearningActionReserve{
		Schema:    StudentPracticeLearningActionReserveSchema,
		StudentID: "11111111-1111-4111-8111-111111111111", TaskInstanceID: "22222222-2222-4222-8222-222222222222",
		TaskRevisionID: "33333333-3333-4333-8333-333333333333", LearningActionID: "44444444-4444-4444-8444-444444444444",
		IdempotencyKey: "22222222-2222-4222-8222-222222222222", TaskRevisionDigest: "sha256:aaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaa",
		SurfaceClassification: "practice", LearningTargets: []LearningTargetRef{{Type: LearningTargetConcept, Key: "go.interfaces", Version: "v1"}}, OccurredAt: time.Now(),
	}
	input.TaskInstanceID = "22222222-2222-4222-8222-22222222222A"
	input.IdempotencyKey = input.TaskInstanceID
	if _, err := NormalizePracticeLearningActionReserve(input); err == nil {
		t.Fatal("uppercase UUID must be rejected")
	}
	input.TaskInstanceID, input.IdempotencyKey = "22222222-2222-4222-8222-222222222222", "22222222-2222-4222-8222-222222222222"
	input.TaskRevisionDigest = "sha256:AAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAA"
	if _, err := NormalizePracticeLearningActionReserve(input); err == nil {
		t.Fatal("uppercase digest must be rejected")
	}
	input.TaskRevisionDigest = "sha256:aaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaa"
	input.LearningActionID = input.TaskRevisionID
	if _, err := NormalizePracticeLearningActionReserve(input); err == nil {
		t.Fatal("action ID must differ from revision ID")
	}
}
